resultView.description: Client-side view of one player's result, assembled in the browser after reading records (there is no server implementing query lexicons in v1).

did.description: DID of the player who recorded this result.

handle.description: Resolved handle of the player, if available.

solved.description: Whether the player solved the puzzle.

guessCount.description: Guesses used; present only when solved.

leaderboardEntry.description: One aggregated row of a daily leaderboard, computed in the browser from result records discovered via Constellation.

handle.description: Resolved handle of the player, if available.

solved.description: Whether the player solved the puzzle.

guessCount.description: Guesses used; present only when solved.

dailyStats.description: Aggregate statistics for one (lang, puzzleNumber), computed in the browser. Counts are read live from Constellation and never stored on any record.

players.description: Distinct DIDs that recorded a result for this puzzle.

solvers.description: How many of those players solved it.

averageGuesses.description: Average winning guess count, scaled by 100 (integer to avoid float ambiguity); e.g. 412 means 4.12. Absent when there are no solvers.

guessDistribution.description: Histogram of winning guess counts across all solvers.
